summary: Short residential kerb with parked cars, but homes sit 11-13 m away on the same side.

best_section.where: south kerb of Ward Street, among the parked cars west of the bus sign

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 11 m and detached houses 13 m from the kerb on the same side; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside parking lane with several cars already parked; room for a van.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs; school-day bus zone 3:10-3:30pm only.

sun_shade: Mostly open; some small trees on the south verge give patchy shade.
